info.title: UnderPass Public API
info.description: Public API for browsing events and selling tickets on the UnderPass platform. Build a custom event landing or checkout on your own domain: list events, reserve tickets at selection, sell numbered seats, run a waiting room, start a checkout and poll the order. Everything added since 1.0 is optional and opt-in per event; a storefront built against 1.0 keeps working.

Sets the selected tickets aside for the session for the event's hold window (`event.hold_minutes`); they leave everyone else's `available`. Replaces the session's previous hold on this event. On a NUMBERED locality without `seat_ids` the best available contiguous seats are assigned.

post.summary: Join (or return to) an event's waiting room
post.description: Takes the next number. When the doors are open and the serving number has already reached it (a quiet room), the entry is ADMITTED on the spot; otherwise it returns the place in line. Before `waiting_room_opens_at` the entry pre-queues with no number: the order is drawn at random when the doors open. The entry id is the pass to send as `queue_pass` once ADMITTED. An expired or left entry re-joins at the back.

400.description: `QUEUE_NOT_ENABLED`: the event has no waiting room

get.description: A read: admission is arithmetic on the entry's number against the event's serving number, which advances continuously at `rate` per minute, so polling neither moves the line nor keeps a place. Poll after `poll_after_ms`. Nobody is dropped for not polling: a number that has already been served reads ADMITTED (while its pass lives) or EXPIRED when you come back.

post.description: Returns the allowed document types for a set of ticket types based on their locality configurations.

Initiates a checkout session for purchasing tickets. Returns a redirect URL for payment.

Purchase limits are enforced here — a `400` carries a machine `code` your UI should branch on:

| `code` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `INSUFFICIENT_TICKETS` | Not enough inventory for the requested quantity. |
| `MAX_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED` | An item exceeds its ticket type's `max_per_order`. |
| `MAX_TICKETS_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED` | Total tickets exceed the event's `max_tickets_per_order`. |
| `MAX_TICKETS_PER_EMAIL_EXCEEDED` | The buyer email reached the event's `max_tickets_per_email` across its live orders. |

Error bodies follow `{ code, message, detail }` — `detail` includes the limit and the requested amount.

400.description: Invalid request or a rule failed: `INSUFFICIENT_TICKETS`, `MAX_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED`, `MAX_TICKETS_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED`, `MAX_TICKETS_PER_EMAIL_EXCEEDED`, `PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED`, `ATTENDEE_COUNT_MISMATCH`, `SEAT_COUNT_MISMATCH`, `BAR_PERK_*`, `TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED`

403.description: `QUEUE_PASS_REQUIRED` / `QUEUE_PASS_INVALID`: the event has a waiting room and the order carries neither a hold nor an admitted pass.

409.description: `HOLD_EXPIRED` / `HOLD_NOT_ACTIVE`: the reservation ran out; `SEAT_TAKEN`: a picked seat was taken meanwhile.

get.description: Returns the current status of an order/checkout session, including payment status and tickets if completed.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order ID from the checkout session

quantity.description: Units of the ticket type. Tickets generated = quantity × group_size.

performance_id.description: Required on every item when the event has several dates (`PERFORMANCE_REQUIRED` otherwise). Omit for single-date events.

seat_ids.description: Numbered seating: the seats to buy, exactly quantity × group_size, all in the zone of this ticket type. Omitted on a NUMBERED locality = best available contiguous seats (or the hold's seats).

attendees.description: One attendee per generated ticket (quantity × group_size, in order). Each ticket is then issued and emailed to its attendee. Required when the event has `require_individual_data`. Wrong length = `ATTENDEE_COUNT_MISMATCH`.

checkout_session_id.description: Checkout session ID from payment provider (null for free orders)

payment_provider.description: `bold` / `epayco` = redirect to the hosted payment page; `FREE` = zero-amount order, `redirect_url` is your confirmation URL.

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect customer - for paid orders goes to payment provider, for free orders goes to order confirmation

total_amount.description: Order total in integer COP: ticket subtotal after discounts, plus bar perks, plus the buyer-facing service fee. Use it as the InitiateCheckout pixel value.

expires_at.description: Checkout session expiration time (null for free orders)

status.description: `CONFIRMED` = fully paid, tickets issued. `PARTIALLY_PAID` = first installment paid: count it as a sale (fire Purchase once), tickets issued when fully paid.

EventDto.description: Full event payload returned by the public events endpoints.

min_initial_payment_pct.description: Required initial payment % when split payment is enabled.

pulep.description: Colombian regulatory identifier. Empty string when not set.

organizer_terms_url.description: URL to organizer terms page. Empty string when not set.

show_exact_availability.description: When false, render "Disponible"/"Agotado" instead of exact counts.

max_tickets_per_order.description: Maximum total tickets (quantity x group_size) a single order may contain. `null` = unlimited. Enforced server-side at checkout start (`MAX_TICKETS_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED`); cap your quantity selector to this value.

max_tickets_per_email.description: Maximum total tickets a single customer email can accumulate across live (pending/confirmed) orders for this event. `null` = unlimited. Enforced server-side at checkout start (`MAX_TICKETS_PER_EMAIL_EXCEEDED`).

require_individual_data.description: When true, checkout collects per-attendee info (one block per ticket × quantity).

payment_provider.description: Active PSP of the organizer: `bold` or `epayco`. The hosted payment page is theirs.

ticketAvailability.description: One row per ticket type × selling stage on sale now. Summed across performances unless `?performance_id=` narrows it.

processing_fee_rate.description: Informational. Do not derive any buyer-facing price from it.

ticket_commission_rate.description: Buyer-facing service fee as a percentage of the ticket subtotal, charged on top. The only rate to use for fee math. 0 = no fee. See Fees & installments.

hold_minutes.description: Minutes a reservation (`POST /api/checkout/holds`) stays active before checkout. Default 10.

waiting_room.description: When true, `POST /api/checkout/holds` (and `checkout/start` without `hold_id`) require an admitted `queue_pass` from `/api/checkout/queue`.

waiting_room_opens_at.description: Doors-open time of the waiting room. Before it buyers pre-queue and are drawn at random at opening. `null` = open from the start (only paces the flow).

waiting_room_minutes.description: Minutes an admitted pass stays valid.

performances.description: The event's dates ("funciones"). Hidden drafts are never included. With several dates each carries `total_available`, `from_price`, `sold_out`; every item then needs `performance_id`.

success_url.description: URL to redirect after successful payment

cancel_url.description: URL to redirect after cancelled payment

installment_count.description: 1 = pay in full; 2+ = split payment (requires `event.allows_split_payment`, max `event.max_payment_count`). The first installment is charged now; the fee is computed per installment.

tracking.description: Marketing attribution and ad-platform matching data captured in the browser. See the Marketing attribution guide.

bar_perks.description: Purchasable bar perks the buyer accepted. Price is read server-side; perks priced 0 are rejected (`BAR_PERK_NOT_PURCHASABLE`).

sales_link_code.description: The sales link the buyer arrived with, so private tiers it unlocks are authorized at checkout, not only shown.

hold_id.description: The reservation made with `POST /api/checkout/holds`. The order takes it over (no second fight for the stock). Without it the order reserves inline at this moment.

queue_pass.description: Waiting-room pass (admitted entry id). Only needed on an event with `waiting_room` when there is no `hold_id`; a hold already went through the line.

fbc.description: Meta `_fbc` cookie (or `fb.1.<ts>.<fbclid>` built from the click id)

client_ip_address.description: The buyer's public IP. When you call the API from a server, forward it from your edge; private addresses are dropped.

fbclid.description: Meta click id from the landing URL

landing_page.description: Full landing URL on first touch

up_aid.description: Reserved for UnderPass storefronts; do not send.

PixelIntegrationDto.description: Public-facing pixel + analytics tag IDs for an event. Initialize each on every page that renders event data (event detail, ticket select, checkout, order confirmation). All values are client-safe — meant to be embedded in browser scripts. **Server-side secrets** (e.g. Meta CAPI access tokens) are NEVER returned by this endpoint and must not be passed by clients.

meta_pixel_id.description: Meta (Facebook) pixel ID. May be a single ID or comma-separated list (e.g. `123,456`). Initialize each separately via `fbq("init", "<id>")`.

google_analytics_id.description: GA4 Measurement ID (`G-XXXXXXXXXX`). Pass to `gtag("config", id)`.

twitter_pixel_id.description: Twitter / X conversion tracking pixel ID.

EventMediaDto.description: Image or video attached to an event. Render `is_primary` first, then sort by `position`.

is_primary.description: Render this as the hero image.

ArtistDto.description: Performer / DJ. Most social fields are nullable.

EventArtistDto.description: Lineup entry. Sort by `position` ascending when rendering the lineup.

performance_type.description: Artist role. Treat unknown values as "support".

LocalityDto.description: A logical seating zone within an event (e.g. GENERAL, BACKSTAGE). Tickets are scoped to a locality.

allowed_document_types.description: Empty array means all document types are allowed.

seating.description: `NUMBERED`: this locality's ticket types sell specific seats (see the seating endpoints). Default `GENERAL`.

TicketTypeDto.description: A purchasable ticket variant within a locality. Pricing varies per `SellingStage`.

group_size.description: People admitted per unit (1 = single ticket, 4 = a table for four). Everything the API counts multiplies `quantity × group_size`.

max_per_order.description: Maximum quantity of this ticket type in a single order. `null` = unlimited. Enforced server-side at checkout start (`MAX_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED`); also cap your UI selector.

requires_info.description: When true, buyer must fill in attendee info per ticket at checkout.

promoter_commission.description: Commission paid to promoters per sold ticket. **Decimal serialized as string** — parse before doing math (`parseFloat(promoter_commission)`).

entry_cutoff.description: Time-restricted ticket: the holder must enter before this time; a later scan is flagged as a late arrival at the gate. Informational, show it before purchase.

late_fee.description: Integer COP the organizer charges a late arrival at the door. Informational.

min_consumption.description: Integer COP minimum spend the organizer collects at the door. Informational.

barPerks.description: What the ticket gives at the bar. `price: 0` = included; `price > 0` = purchasable add-on (send it in `bar_perks` at checkout).

StagePricingDto.description: Price of a TicketType within a specific SellingStage.

price.description: Price in `currency` integer units (no decimals for COP). **Decimal serialized as string** — parse with `parseInt(price, 10)` for display.

visibility.description: `PRIVATE` tickets only appear when unlocked via a sales link or promo code.

SellingStageDto.description: A sales window for an event. Each ticket type has a `StagePricing` row per stage.

max_tickets.description: Hard cap across all ticket types in this stage. `null` = uncapped.

is_hidden.description: Hidden stages are only revealed by promo codes that grant `UNLOCK_STAGE`.

stagePricing.description: Pricing per ticket type in this stage. Included on `ticketAvailability[].sellingStage`.

TicketAvailabilityDto.description: The denormalized "what to render in the ticket picker" view. One entry per (TicketType × currently-active SellingStage) — already filtered to what the buyer can actually purchase right now.

totalDelta.description: Total available units across the locality.

available.description: Sellable right now: stock minus what other buyers currently hold (carts and unpaid orders). Render "Agotado" when `<= 0`; held tickets come back when those holds expire.

reserved.description: Tickets other buyers are holding at this moment.

performance_id.description: The date these numbers are for; `null` when summed across several dates.

OrganizerDto.description: Public-facing organizer info shown on event pages. On the list endpoint only `collective` is populated; on the by-slug endpoint the legal / contact fields are also included so the page can render a full organizer card.

legalRepresentative.description: Legal entity name. Slug endpoint only.

email.description: Public contact email for the organizer. Slug endpoint only.

phone.description: Public contact phone for the organizer. Slug endpoint only.

nit.description: Colombian tax ID (NIT). Slug endpoint only.

total_available.description: Only when the event has several dates.

from_price.description: Lowest sellable price for this date; only with several dates.

quantity.description: How many of the product/combo one ticket earns. Ignored for credit.

price.description: Integer COP the buyer pays for this perk. 0 = already inside the ticket.

optional.description: A purchasable perk the buyer may decline. Always false when price is 0.

count.description: Capped server-side at the tickets of that ticket type in the order.

seat_ids.description: Numbered seating: seats to claim, quantity × group_size. Omitted = best available.

session_key.description: Opaque per-browser id, 8 to 128 characters. Owns the hold; one ACTIVE hold per session per event (a new POST replaces it).

queue_pass.description: Waiting-room pass, required when the event has `waiting_room`.

expires_at.description: Show a countdown; at zero the tickets are back on sale.

session_key.description: Same session key as the holds.

id.description: The pass: send as `queue_pass` once `status` is ADMITTED.

number.description: The queue number ("take a number"); null while pre-queuing, before the draw at opening. Admission happens when the event's serving number reaches it.

position.description: 1-based place in line; null while pre-queuing (drawn at opening) or once admitted.

poll_after_ms.description: When to poll again, in milliseconds: about 3 s when the turn is near, up to 60 s far back in the line, jittered so a crowd does not poll in step. Polling sooner changes nothing.

color.description: Hex colour the organizer picked for the zone.

ticket_type_id.description: The ticket type that sells this zone's seats.

x.description: Chart units on a width × height canvas

zone_key.description: Overrides the section's zone when set.
